comparison.objective: Remove one guide comb, select number 4, and snap it onto a loose hair clipper; candidate locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Part selection, snap-fit removal/insertion, and stabilizing a loose appliance versus driver/wrench seating and opposed torque.
comparison.success_condition: Requires the correct guide clipped square and retained, other guides undisturbed, release, stillness, and no drops; candidate requires a precise stop setting retained through three cycles.
comparison.reason: Snap-fit replacement and correct-part selection do not test coupled screw-and-jam-nut adjustment, despite shared retention and release checks.
